gripOrHq.title: Live News Feed
gripOrHq.rulesText: Make a run. If run is successful, the Corp gives you two tags, and you give the Corp 1 Bad Publicity point for each black ice you encountered during the run, 1 for each Black Ops card the Corp rezzed during the run, and 1 for each Black Ops agenda you liberated during the run. If the Corp has 7 or more Bad Publicity points, it loses the game, even if it fulfills victory conditions at the same time.

gripOrHq.title: Scaldan
gripOrHq.rulesText: After each successful run on HQ, give the Corp a Scaldan counter. Each Scaldan counter forces the Corp to roll a die at the start of each of its turns. On a 5 or a 6, the Corp gains 1 Bad Publicity point. The Corp may remove all Virus counters at any time, but must then forgo its next three actions. If the Corp has 7 or more Bad Publicity points, it loses the game, even if it fulfills victory conditions at the same time.

gripOrHq.title: Poisoned Water Supply
gripOrHq.rulesText: Play only if you have at least two connections in play. Trash two connections. Give the Corp 1 Bad Publicity point. If the Corp has 7 or more Bad Publicity points, it loses the game, even if it fulfills victory conditions at the same time.

heapOrArchives.title: Frame-Up
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Play only if you made a successful run on both HQ and R&D this turn. Give the Corp 1 Bad Publicity point. Give the Corp 1 additional Bad Publicity point if you liberated or trashed any Black Ops cards during those runs. If the Corp has 7 or more Bad Publicity points, it loses the game, even if it fulfills victory conditions at the same time.

heapOrArchives.title: Disgruntled Ice Technician
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Make a run. After passing a piece of ice during this run, you may derez that ice and end your run if you broke all the subroutines of that ice.

heapOrArchives.title: Remote Detonator
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Play only if you made a successful run on a data fort this turn. Trash all rezzed ice on that fort, and the Corp gives you three tags.

heapOrArchives.title: Bolt-Hole
heapOrArchives.rulesText: [T]: Prevent 2 meat damage. Hidden resources are installed face down, but are put into the trash face up.

heapOrArchives.title: Demolition Run
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Make a run. If run is successful, do not access cards; instead, trash all rezzed ice on the fort on which you just made a run, and the Corp gives you three tags.

heapOrArchives.title: R&D Mole
heapOrArchives.rulesText: [4], [T]: Access two additional cards from R&D. Use this ability only when accessing cards from R&D. Hidden resources are installed face down, but are put into the trash face up.

heapOrArchives.title: Streetware Distributor
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Take [1] from Streetware Distributor, if it has any bits, at the start of each of your turns. A: Put [3] from the bank on Streetware Distributor.

heapOrArchives.title: Demolition Run
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Make a run. If run is successful, do not access cards; instead, trash all rezzed ice on the fort on which you just made a run, and the Corp gives you three tags.

heapOrArchives.title: Airport Locker
heapOrArchives.rulesText: [5], [T]: Search your stack for a program, and install that program, if you can. Shuffle your stack afterwards. You may use this ability during an encounter with a piece of ice. Hidden resources are installed face down, but are put into the trash face up.

rig.title: Crumble
rig.rulesText: After each successful run on HQ, give the Corp a Crumble counter. Two or more Crumble counters allow you trash, at no cost, any cards accessed from HQ, even if the cards cannot normally be trashed. The Corp may remove all Virus counters at any time, but must then forgo its next three actions.

rig.title: Krash
rig.rulesText:
2 credits: Break ice subroutine.
2 credits: +1 strength.

rig.title: Death from Above
rig.rulesText: [T]: Trash, at no cost, all cards installed in a subsidiary data fort, even if they cannot normally be trashed. Use this ability only when you have just successfully made a run on that fort, and before accessing cards from that fort. Hidden resources are installed face down, but are put into the trash face up.

scoreArea.title: Genetics-Visionary Acquisition
scoreArea.rulesText: Difficulty of Research agendas is reduced by 1.

scoreArea.title: Encryption Breakthrough
scoreArea.rulesText: All code gates have +1 strength. When you score Encryption Breakthrough, reveal as many code gates as you wish. Then, gain [1] for each revealed or rezzed code gate.

scoreArea.title: Polymer Breakthrough
scoreArea.rulesText: Gain [1] at the start of each of your turns.

ice.title: Ball and Chain
ice.rulesText: [Subroutine] For the remainder of the run, Runner must pay [2] when encountering a piece of ice, in addition to any other costs, or end the run.

ice.title: Banpei
ice.rulesText:
[Subroutine] Trash a program.
[Subroutine] End the run.

root.title: Chimera
root.rulesText: When Runner accesses Chimera, trash a daemon.

root.title: BBS Whispering Campaign
root.rulesText: Put [16] from the bank on BBS Whispering Campaign when you rez it.  When all the bits have been removed, trash BBS Whispering Campaign. A: Take [2] from BBS Whispering Campaign.

root.title: Chicago Branch
root.rulesText: A, [3]: Add two advancement counters to an installed card that can be advanced.

root.title: Management Shake-Up
root.rulesText: Add three advancement counters to any combination of installed cards that can be advanced.

ice.title: Code Corpse
ice.rulesText:
[Subroutine] Do 1 brain damage.
[Subroutine] Do 1 brain damage.
[Subroutine] End the run.
